hero.headline: An Authentic Heart-to-Heart Trip
hero.subheadline: Recently, I realized life is too short for “we should catch up sometime.” So let’s actually do it properly. In Porto and Vienna from Nov 18-25, 2026.

problem.title: Celebrate Shikhin’s 50th birthday
problem.subtitle: Come visit two of my favorite places in Europe and bond with my favorite people. Think: real conversations, great walks, memorable meals, and just enough nonsense to keep us humble.

items.title: Porto, Portugal · Nov 18–22
items.description: Steep cobbled streets, river views, tiled facades, and port wine on the Douro. The perfect backdrop for the main birthday celebration.

items.title: Vienna, Austria · Nov 22–25
items.description: Vienna is where I discovered the kind of art I actually love—and the kind I hope to pursue one day. Also: coffee so good it feels judgmental.

solution.title: What, When, Where?
solution.subtitle: One thoughtfully designed week for brotherhood, culture, and ease. Basically, the best parts of my favorite trips, without the chaos.

items.title: 📅 Wednesday, Nov 18 → Wednesday, Nov 25, 2026
items.description: Porto Nov 18–22, then Vienna Nov 22–25. Ideally arrive Nov 18 and leave Nov 25 just in time to be back before Thanksgiving.

items.title: 🎂 The main birthday moment: Saturday, Nov 20
items.description: This is the heart of the trip. We’ll be together in Porto, cutting the ‘cake,’ raising a glass. Celebrate life and friendships.

items.title: ✈️ Flexible travel dates
items.description: Come for the full week, or just part of it. Join in Porto or Vienna. Leave when life calls. You join for what you can and would love to see you.

how_it_works.title: Trip Details
how_it_works.subtitle: Seven easy, well-paced days across two cities — designed for great conversations, great walks, and zero logistical headaches.

steps.title: Wednesday, Nov 18 — Arrival in Porto
steps.time: Land, decompress, and ease into the week
items: Morning: Arrivals into Porto (OPO) from wherever you’re coming from
Daytime: Check in, stretch your legs, light wandering or napping
Afternoon: Walk down to the Ribeira riverfront
Evening: Welcome dinner at a great local Porto restaurant
Hotel: Crowne Plaza Porto (Av. da Boavista) — see Hotels section for pricing

steps.title: Thursday, Nov 19 — Porto, Culture & Conversation
steps.time: History, walking, and finding our rhythm
items: Morning: Guided Porto walking tour (history + neighborhoods, not a lecture)
Daytime: Free time for cafés, shopping, bookstores, or just wandering
Late afternoon: Port wine tasting across the river in Vila Nova de Gaia
Evening: Dinner TBD
Late night (optional): Cocktail lounge or Porto nightlife

steps.title: Friday, Nov 20 — Porto (Birthday Day)
items: Morning: Easy morning, coffee and pastéis de nata
Daytime: Free time or optional Douro riverside stroll
Evening: Main birthday dinner and toasts in Porto
Late night (optional): Porto nightlife

steps.title: Saturday, Nov 21 — Porto, Nature & Old Town
steps.time: Fresh air, beauty, and deep conversations
items: Late morning: Walk the Dom Luís I Bridge for city views
Afternoon: Rest, café hopping, or Ribeira wandering
Evening: Group dinner in Porto’s historic district
Late night (optional): Late evening drink by the river

steps.title: Sunday, Nov 22 — Porto → Vienna
items: Morning: Easy breakfast and check-out
Midday: Flight from Porto to Vienna (flight times to be shared on WhatsApp)
Afternoon: Check into Vienna hotel and walk the city center
Evening: Dinner at my favorite Schnitzel place
Hotel: Crowne Plaza Vienna — see Hotels section for pricing

steps.title: Monday–Tuesday, Nov 23–24 — Vienna, Art & Café Culture
items: Morning: Vienna café breakfast at my favorite bakery
Daytime: Hundertwasser museum
Afternoon: Free time for shopping, walks, or people-watching
Evening: Final group dinner in Vienna
Late night (optional): Relax and recover

steps.title: Wednesday, Nov 25 — Return Home
items: Morning: Departures from Vienna. Travel back home in time for Thanksgiving

client_experience.title: The Experience
client_experience.subtitle: How this week should feel: easy, meaningful, and genuinely connecting (with enough free time to pretend you’re ‘just wandering’).

testimonial.quote: It felt like a reset—great conversations, great cities, and none of the usual planning stress. I came back better (and annoyingly refreshed).
testimonial.author: Past Traveler

hotels.title: Hotels: Crowne Plaza
hotels.subtitle: Our group hotel in both cities. Book directly with IHG and mention the Brotherhood Trip on WhatsApp so we can keep everyone together. Rates below are indicative, taken from public booking sites; confirm live rates for your dates on IHG before booking.

items.name: Crowne Plaza Porto
items.note: Roughly €440–€600 for 4 nights per room. Check-in 2:00 PM, check-out 12:00 PM.

items.name: Crowne Plaza Vienna
items.note: Roughly €300+ for 3 nights per room depending on room type. November rates have been seen near €102/night for a standard room.
